summary: Iteration 86 testing complete — Backend: all 14 pytest cases passed (100%) covering invoice CRUD, convert-to-sale, stock decrement, convert-twice rejection, resource auto-serial, custom serial, regenerate, public by-serial lookup, and 404 handling. Frontend: Invoices tab/editor/total computation all working. Public /resource/{serial} page renders without auth and shows all expected fields. Found ONE frontend bug: clicking 'Issue 58:12 Serial Number' button on a resource card shows 'Failed' toast despite backend returning 200 — caused by calling undefined `fetchResources()` (actual function name is `fetchData`).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Issue 58:12 Serial Number' button shows 'Failed' toast even though backend returns 200 OK and serial is persisted. Root cause: line 232 calls `fetchResources()` which is undefined — actual fetch function is named `fetchData` (defined at line 57). The ReferenceError triggers the catch block. Same bug in BulkActionBar onBulkDelete handler at line 191.

issues: Due Date uses browser native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn calendar — inconsistent with rest of app. Dialog missing aria-describedby (a11y warning in console).

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/ResourcesPage.jsx line 232: rename `fetchResources()` → `fetchData()` (or rename the useState fetch function). Apply same fix on line 191 (BulkActionBar onBulkDelete).
Consider replacing native date picker in InvoicesTab editor with shadcn DatePicker for UI consistency.
Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to New Invoice dialog to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: invoices.py uses invoice_number as the document id (id = invoice_number). That's fine but be aware: PUT/GET endpoints use id OR invoice_number lookup — slight redundancy.
Convert endpoint decrements stock via $inc without checking if sufficient stock exists — could go negative. Consider adding a stock check or atomic guarded update.
Convert endpoint does not reverse stock if sale insert fails midway — no transaction. Minor risk in concurrent scenarios.

Serial format prefix `5812-` is duplicated across country+abbr string; `loc_419f5d5e` does not exist in DB (actual Uganda location id is loc_001 with country='USA' based on actual data), so test environment uses US not UG — not a code bug but a data/doc mismatch that the problem statement should clarify.
ResourcesPage.jsx: undefined function call `fetchResources()` — ESLint/react-hooks would catch this if enabled with no-undef.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (core flows work; generate-serial UI has a JS error)

seed_data_creation: Auto-generated serial on res_002 (Conference Room A): 5812-USCEN-030526-0001. Created+deleted TEST_ invoices and resources via tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: One-line fix in ResourcesPage.jsx (fetchResources→fetchData or rename). Backend router /api/invoices and /api/resources/by-serial are fully functional. Locations seeded in DB have country='USA' (loc_001) not Uganda, so serial prefix comes out as 5812-USCEN-* not 5812-UGUGA-* as the problem statement suggested — confirm expected behavior with user if that's a concern.
rca of the issue: Frontend 'Failed' toast bug: In /app/frontend/src/pages/ResourcesPage.jsx, the generate-serial button's onClick handler (line 228-233) awaits resourcesApi.generateSerial() successfully (backend returns 200 + correct payload), then calls `fetchResources()` in the try block to refresh state. However, the fetch function is declared as `fetchData` at line 57 — `fetchResources` is not defined in scope, causing a ReferenceError that is swallowed by the surrounding catch block which shows the generic 'Failed' toast. Reproduction: navigate to /resources → click 'Issue 58:12 Serial Number' on any card without serial → observe 'Failed' toast. Expected: success toast + card updates to show serial+Label button. Fix: rename the function call (one-line change).
